'''Stun panels''' were coated in a conductive [[Polymer/Legends|polymer]] that allowed [[Stun/Legends|stun]] energy to be run through them in varying intensities so that it either stunned or harmed anyone who came into contact with it. [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company's]] [[JX40 Jailspeeder]], a [[repulsorwagon]] used by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], was covered in stun panels.<ref name="HSCSS" /> Stun panels were also used in the construction of [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stuncuffs]] such as [[Locris Syndicated Securities/Legends|Locris Syndicated Securities']] [[SC-401 stun cuffs|SC-401 model]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
